milestones.label: MILESTONES THIS LEVEL
milestones.micro: milestone point -> spend NOW in a FLARED constellation  |  level-up COMET -> spend NOW, anywhere, Flared or not

attributes.label: ATTRIBUTES
attributes.micro: pts / 4, round down, max +5; adds to EVERY check

defense.label: DEFENSES
defense.ac_micro: check = d20 + Attribute + Proficiency; Threshold = 10 + Attribute + Proficiency. Level never touches the die
defense.ladder_micro: Strain = armor + shield Load - matched harness - Endure relief: off Climb, Swim, Stealth. Wind, each round: Endure vs 10 + Strain or Fatigued +1 (max 3); no roll if Endure Threshold meets it.
defenses: Presence + prof + Gear (Raised shield / Parry wpn)
defense.zone_micro: Protection comes off every instance of damage on that Zone, Grazes included (never below 1). Hits go to the Torso unless a Zone is Exposed: then a ❷/❸ Strike may land there at Protection 0, and a crit there Wounds it. Recenter ❶ clears Exposed and ends any Bind.

hints.HEAD: 1st Wound: no Reactions  |  final: Dying, unconscious
hints.TORSO: 1st Wound: Off-Guard, 1d4 persistent bleed  |  final: Dying
hints.ARMS: 1st Wound: -2 Situation to attacks and Guard  |  final: arm useless, drop it
hints.LEGS: 1st Wound: Speed halved  |  final: Prone, cannot Stand

wounds.micro: Wounds are per Zone (capacity 2 for Medium): a crit on an Exposed Zone with a ❷/❸ Strike, or any Hit while Spent. Recenter and rest never clear them: treating one is 10 minutes and Endure vs 10 + Wounds carried; a week of Downtime heals it. A Wound to a useless Arm or Leg goes to the Torso.

dying.label: DYING (1 to 5)
dying.micro: Torso or Head final Wound = Dying 1 (2 from a crit). Recovery each round: Endure vs 10 + Dying + Wounds carried. Damage while Dying +1 (+2 crit); Dying 5 is death.

hp.label: VIGOR
hp.micro: 10 + Opening Vigor + (Ancestry + Endure Bonus) x level
hp.spent_micro: 0 Vigor: still standing, but every Hit Wounds the Zone struck, a crit twice; Grazes never Wound. Temp Vigor: one pool, larger replaces, spent first.

speed_init.init_micro: initiative is usually an Awareness check: Wits + Awareness proficiency (helm penalty applies)
speed_init.move_micro: Speed = feet per Move ❶ (Human 6). Step ❶ = half Speed, never provokes. Rush ❸ = 5 x Speed in a straight line, minus Load Strain. Leap ❶ = 10 ft minus Load Strain, or 3 ft up. Total Reach = natural (Medium 2 ft) + weapon.

actions.label: ACTIONS
actions.micro: six at the start of each round; unspent ones expire
actions.pass_micro: One Maneuver per Opportunity, or Pass. ⓿ is free and keeps your Opportunity. Reactions ↺ spend from the same six, on anyone's Opportunity. A full circuit of Passes ends the round. Preparing ❸: 1 now, the rest reserved; finish or abandon at your next Opportunity.

trees.label: TALENT CONSTELLATIONS
trees.micro: pts: 1 Trained +3 | 4 Expert +6 | 9 Master +9 | 16 Legendary +12 (L1/5/10/15); attribute adds on top
trees.foot1: FLR = Flared: crit success OR crit failure on a roll WITH CONSEQUENCES related to a talent in the constellation, opened or not (enemy rolls against you count) - or a GM award, or a week's training. Max 1 new Flare per constellation per session.
trees.foot2: Defenses are Constellations: two Trained at creation, your choice; an Untrained Defense still adds its Attribute. Melee and Ranged are parents: points in a Combat Style count toward the parent's rank. Armor never touches a Defense; it subtracts Protection from damage.

melee_ranged.micro: Melee: any weapon in your hand. Ranged: anything that leaves it, a thrown dagger included. Weapon dice: 1, then 2 at L4, 3 at L8, 4 at L12, 5 at L16. Specialization +2 Expert, +3 Master, +4 Legendary.

attacks.label: STRIKES
attacks.micro: atk = d20 + Strike Attribute + Melee or Ranged proficiency  |  Strike Attribute = the higher of the weapon's (Might; Agility if Finesse or Ranged) and your Combat Style's Key Attribute  |  no multiple attack penalty

reactions.label: REACTIONS
reactions.micro: tick the ones your Training (or rank) grants; each costs ❶ of the six, on anyone's Opportunity. Stance: Evade | Guard | Void | Parry | Counter.
items: Guard Training; rigid weapon or shield in hand. Guard +2 Situation. Stops a ❷/❸ Strike: take Control and riposte with a Quick Strike ⓿.
Evade Training. Evade +2 Situation. If the attack is Stopped, Step in any direction.
Melee Expert. Answer a melee Blow within your Reach with a Quick Strike; no Defense bonus; both resolve.
Melee Training. A foe Moves into your Total Reach (or Strikes with an Unwieldy weapon inside its distance): Quick Strike as they enter. Once per foe per Move.

bind.label: BIND
bind.micro: Guard with a rigid implement Stops a blow: neutral Bind. Parry Stops ❷/❸, or Guard answers a Miss: Control. Controlling: your partner has an Exposed Zone of your choice and -2 with that weapon; you may Close ❶. Ends when a Strike between you resolves, either Moves, Steps (Close excepted) or Recenters, a third party attacks the Controller, or the implement drops.

talents.label: TALENTS
talents.micro: name - effect in your own words (full text: page 2 / handbook)

banked.label: HERO POINTS
banked.micro1: 1 at session start, max 3; spend 1 to reroll any check, taking the new result;
banked.micro2: spend all (min 1) to refuse death. Talent points are NEVER banked: spend on receipt.

footer: RESULT (you roll; the same bands read from either side): beat the Threshold by 10+ = Critical Hit: double damage, attacker picks the Zone  |  meet or beat = Hit: full damage to the Torso, or to an Exposed Zone for ❷/❸  |  miss by less than 10 = Graze: one weapon die to a Zone the defender picks (min 1), position shifts the defender's way  |  miss by 10+ = Miss: nothing lands, attacker Exposed (defender's choice)  |  natural 20/1 steps one degree  |  either crit on a consequential roll Flares the Constellation.

STRIKES: ❶ Quick: a probe. One die + precision, on the Torso; no crit unless Agile; full Protection; Stopped, it costs nothing.  ❷ Deliberate: all dice + specialization + Might; may land on an Exposed Zone (Protection 0); a Miss Exposes you.  ❸ Committed: Prepared (1 now, 2 reserved, resolves at your next Opportunity) and Weighted: as Deliberate, any Hit may Expose a plausible Zone, and a Graze or Miss Exposes you. A Parry that Stops ❷/❸ takes Control of your weapon.

ANSWERING: Blow: Evade or Guard  |  Blast: Evade or Endure  |  Blight: Endure or Awareness  |  Beguilement: Awareness or Guard. Guard answers a ranged Blow only with a shield Raised; no Evade while Grabbed. The basic Defense is free; a Reaction ↺ costs ❶ of the same six; a Posture ⓿↺ buys +2 Situation and Exposes a Zone until the end of the round. Support: +1 Situation to melee attacks per ally with the target in Reach, max +2. Evading a Graze gives 3 ft; a Guard with a rigid implement binds.

DAMAGE: ❷/❸ Hit = weapon dice + specialization + Might + bonuses - Protection  |  ❶ Hit = one die + precision - Protection  |  Graze = one die - Protection (min 1). A crit doubles dice and modifiers before Protection; a Deadly die lands after. Order: Immunity, total, Weakness, Resistance, double, Protection, Temporary Vigor, Vigor. Persistent damage lands at the end of the round; Endure vs 10 + the amount ends it.

GOING DOWN: 0 Vigor = Spent: every Hit Wounds the Zone struck, a crit twice; Grazes never Wound. A Torso or Head final Wound = Dying 1 (2 from a crit): unconscious; damage while Dying +1 (+2 crit); Dying 5 = dead. Recovery at the start of each round: Endure vs 10 + Dying + Wounds carried; crit success = up with 1 Vigor; success -1 (0 = stable); failure +1; crit failure +2. Refuse death: spend all Hero Points, Dying 0, stable at 0 Vigor, Wounds remain.

page2.gear_label: GEAR (no math - stories, traits and properties)
page2.log_micro: what ignited each constellation - the story of your build, one crit at a time
page2.footer: RETRAINING: a month of Downtime moves 1 already spent Talent Point. TRAIN: 7 days with a teacher, rival, or manual Flares that Constellation, once between Milestones.
